clauses.title: External observation is per-run and never carried forward
requires: Before the first Sol invocation, take exactly one external-review snapshot for the current head; that snapshot is the observation origin.
It is not polling and does not delay internal review.
External evidence is not carried across runs.
An undeterminable state is reported as unknown rather than complete.
Findings the workflow raises itself do carry, since their identities are assigned here rather than by a provider.
